content: Moved closure route to invokable WelcomeController for M1 route:cache fix
Replaced str_shuffle with CSPRNG-based RecoveryCodeGenerator for M2, deduping logic across both controllers
Documented SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE=true for production for M5
M6: tag user-submitted job_roles/job_titles with source='user' for a cleanup path. M7: escape LIKE wildcards and cap query length in autocomplete search.
M8: admin_action_logs FKs changed from cascadeOnDelete to nullOnDelete so deleting a user doesn't erase the audit trail
M9: offline reconnect now actually retries the save instead of being a no-op; 422 errors surface the real field message instead of a generic one
M10: added onError handlers + error banner to share modal (was silent on all 8 router calls) and notes panel; fixed notes draft being cleared on failed save

M11: converted live json columns (resumes.section_order, experiences.bullets, projects.highlights, resume_snapshots.document, starter_profiles.experience_snapshot/skills, users.profile) to jsonb on pgsql only. Skipped media.* (unused package, see M15) and passkeys.credential (vendor-owned table) and saved_sections.fields (dead table, no model)
M12: forward-only drop of orphaned referral_events table (no model/controller exists)
M13: documented production log defaults (LOG_STACK=daily, LOG_LEVEL=warning)
M14: updated AI env block comment to reflect C3's keep decision - it's a real, tested feature shipped disabled, not dead scaffolding

M15: removed smalot/pdfparser and spatie/laravel-medialibrary (dead, confirmed unused in app/), deleted config/media-library.php, dropped orphaned media table. Kept npm axios and web-vitals — both are actively used (axios by the kept AI feature's use-resume-ai.ts, web-vitals by app.tsx's dev console reporting), so the audit's dead-dependency claim didn't hold for those two.

M16: added labels to PublicShare gate inputs, aria-label to share-modal switches, and a real keyboard-accessible toggle button (aria-expanded/aria-controls) for section collapse instead of aria-expanded on a div
L1: added url:http,https validation to linkedin/website/projects.*.url to close dormant href-XSS, matching UpdateStarterProfileRequest's existing convention
L2: removed 2FA fields from fillable (write is always direct property assignment, never mass assignment) and added datetime cast to stale_nudge_sent_at

L3: confirmed resumes.target_title was already absent from the live schema (drifted) and dead in app/; added a hasColumn-guarded forward-only drop migration for consistency across environments, corrected CLAUDE.md's claim that it's a live field
L4: fixed updatePersona overwriting the profile JSON instead of merging (matching OnboardingController's established pattern), added a regression test
L5: wrapped all 5 create+seed/save call sites (store's 3 branches, duplicate, createStarterResume) in DB::transaction so a mid-way failure can't leave an empty orphaned resume
L6: capped resume-note body at max:2000, matching the summary field's cap elsewhere
L7: stopped embedding raw pg_dump/psql stderr in the RuntimeException message that BackupController surfaces verbatim to the admin UI; still fully logged via logger()->error
L8: published config/cors.php with allowed_origins locked to [] instead of the framework's permissive '*' default, ahead of any API shipping
